description:
Brand Introduction:

Mandala Canvas is your destination for spiritual and mindfulness-inspired wall decor. We specialize in AI-generated mandala art that transforms living spaces into sanctuaries of peace, balance, and beauty. Rooted in the belief that art has the power to uplift and heal, we bring the calming energy of mandalas into homes around the world. Our mission is to promote mindfulness, inner harmony, and a deeper connection to the universe through high-quality, spiritual art pieces.

 

Product Description:

"Our collection features stunning mandala canvases, meticulously designed to capture the essence of spirituality, nature, and the universe. Each piece is a blend of art and meaning, available in various themes like Healing, Buddha, Earth, and Elephant Mandalas. From serene bedroom decor to inspiring meditation spaces, our canvases serve as both beautiful wall art and spiritual focal points for your home. Perfect for those who value wellness, mindfulness, and home decor that speaks to the soul.

 

USP (Unique Selling Point):

"What sets Mandala Canvas apart is our commitment to art that heals and inspires. Our canvases are not only visually captivating but are imbued with deep spiritual meaning, helping to create calming and balanced environments. We use advanced AI technology to generate unique mandala designs, ensuring that each piece is one of a kind. Our art is more than decoration; it’s a pathway to mindfulness, peace, and a deeper spiritual connection.

Payment Terms:

We offer transparent and timely payment terms for our affiliates. Commissions are paid out monthly, with a minimum payout threshold of $100. Payments are made via secure methods such as PayPal or direct bank transfer, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free experience for our partners. Full details and terms can be accessed through your affiliate dashboard.

Other Information:

As a valued affiliate, you’ll have access to an extensive library of marketing resources, including high-quality images, and promotional content. Our team is here to support your success with ongoing communication, tips, and exclusive updates on upcoming product launches and special offers. Join us in sharing the beauty and power of mandalas, and let’s grow together while inspiring mindfulness and spirituality worldwide. 

  • We are looking for affiliates who are passionate about home decor, spirituality, mindfulness, wellness, and eco-friendly living.
  • Ideal partners include bloggers, influencers, content creators, and social media marketers who engage with audiences interested in meditation, art, and self-improvement
term_and_condition:
1. Program Enrollment:
By applying to become an affiliate, you agree to these terms. We reserve the right to approve or reject any application at our sole discretion.

2. Commissions and Payments:

  • Affiliates will earn commissions for sales made through their unique affiliate links. The exact commission rate is specified in your affiliate account.
  • Payments are made monthly, provided the minimum payout threshold is met. If not, earnings will roll over to the next month.
  • Payment methods and schedules are outlined in the affiliate dashboard.

3. Cookie Duration:
The cookie tracking period is 30 days, meaning you will earn a commission if the customer completes a purchase within 30 days of clicking your link.

4. Promotional Guidelines:

  • Affiliates must use approved marketing materials and adhere to our brand guidelines.
  • Affiliates are prohibited from bidding on our brand name in PPC campaigns or promoting our products through misleading or unethical practices.

5. Termination:
We reserve the right to terminate your affiliate status for any violation of these terms or any activity deemed harmful to our brand.

6. Modification of Terms:
We may update these terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes, and continued participation in the program implies acceptance of the updated terms.
